findings.text: blocking: the added dd:-prefix filter is applied to a source_paths list this same module has already stripped of that prefix. workers.py:10793 sets veto_item['source_paths'] = _bound_docs_review_dd_paths(veto_item), whose return is strip_dd_prefix'd (10387); workers.py:11114 then re-runs _documentation_contradiction_note on that same item, which reads the paths back through the helper at 10931/10384. For a name whose DD path arrives only as a dd:-prefixed source path with no dd binding - the shape tests/standard_names/test_docs_hold_dd_bindings.py:75 guards and the fragment calls 'still held' - the second pass sees a bare path, the filter drops it, required_paths goes empty and the hold is lost. Probed read-only on both arms (run logs/probe_roundtrip.log): the helper returns ['equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/psi'] then [] at head against ['equilibrium/...'] then ['equilibrium/...'] at base, and through 10793 the note at 11114 is None at head against 'DD source text unavailable at equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_1d/psi' at base. This is a live production path (process_review_docs_batch, 11032) and it breaks the brief's explicit 'A DD-bound item with missing text still holds, exactly as now'; the DD text is genuinely absent exactly when _fetch_review_dd_context (10793-10799) attaches no dd_source_docs.
